doc: Restrictions are user data, not program data. The program references them; it never embeds them. Claude calls sd_get_restrictions before generating or modifying any plan.

kinds.movement_ban: A pattern, implement, or exercise that must not appear in any plan. Hard.
kinds.load_cap: A numeric ceiling on an exercise or pattern. Enforced by clamping and by tool rejection.
kinds.range_cap: A range-of-motion limit. Cannot be enforced numerically — renders as persistent inline text.
kinds.monitor: A signal to watch for, with a defined action. Not a restriction on the plan; a restriction on ignoring symptoms.
kinds.gate: A restriction pending external resolution, usually medical clearance. Carries a resolution date and note when lifted.
kinds.preference: User choice, not a medical constraint. Same enforcement, different framing in the UI — nobody wants their dislike of burpees labeled an injury.

scope_types.equipment: barbell | dumbbell | kettlebell | machine | bodyweight | band | spring
scope_types.pattern: horizontal_press | vertical_press | horizontal_pull | vertical_pull | squat | hinge | lunge | carry | isolation
scope_types.joint: shoulder | ac_joint | elbow | wrist | spine_lumbar | hip | knee | ankle
scope_types.exercise_id: targets one exercise in the program
scope_types.exercise_name_match: substring match, for exercises not currently in the plan
scope_types.trait: unilateral | bilateral | overhead | fixed_path | free_path | end_range_stretch | seated | standing

restrictions.label: No barbell pressing
restrictions.reason: Repaired AC separation, right side. A fixed bar path forces end-range shoulder extension. At 315 lb the shoulder failed before the chest.
restrictions.user_note: Dumbbell versions of every one of these are fine — it is specifically the bar.

restrictions.label: AC-provocative movements
restrictions.reason: Same AC repair. These load the joint at end range regardless of implement.

restrictions.label: AC joint symptom watch
watch_for: pain on top of the shoulder at the AC joint, distinct from front-of-shoulder or deltoid soreness
ache persisting into the following day
restrictions.action: Cut seated DB shoulder press first — front delts are already covered by incline pressing and it contributes nothing to the chest priority.
restrictions.escalate: Pain persisting past a week, or any sense of joint instability, goes to an orthopedist before the next push day.

restrictions.label: Loaded lower body — awaiting clearance
restrictions.reason: Right foot modified double arthrodesis with Achilles lengthening; left Achilles procedure. Hindfoot fusion raises load at the joint above it and adjacent-joint arthritis is a documented sequela.
restrictions.effect: Goblet squat and reverse lunge stay bodyweight. Leg developer and RDL proceed normally.
restrictions.resolution_required: Surgeon clearance for loaded lower-body training
restrictions.scope_note: joint:[ankle] was removed — it caught seated calf raise, which is permitted. Pattern alone is the correct scope.

restrictions.label: Ankle-contraindicated patterns
restrictions.reason: Hindfoot fusion removes inversion and eversion — the foot cannot accommodate uneven or angled ground. Achilles lengthening permanently reduces right push-off force.
restrictions.exceptions: Seated calf raise is permitted. Rear-foot-elevated is banned only with the right foot rear.

restrictions.label: Squatting requires heel elevation
restrictions.text: Heels elevated 1–1.5 inches, not optional. If the heels lift or the low back rounds at the bottom, range is being borrowed from the spine because the right ankle cannot supply it.

restrictions.label: No loaded work on unstable or cambered surfaces
restrictions.reason: Fused hindfoot cannot accommodate angled ground.
restrictions.applies_to_conditioning: Rucking: treadmill or known-flat ground only. No trails, no camber.
restrictions.scope_note: Scoped by surface, not pattern. Nothing in the current plan runs on unstable ground; this governs conditioning and any future exercise tagged uneven or cambered.

restrictions.label: Ankle swelling hard stop
watch_for: ankle_r_in more than 0.5 in larger than ankle_l_in
either ankle rising two weeks running
restrictions.action: Suspend rucking and contact the surgeon. Not a variable to push through.
restrictions.instrument_status: UNARMED — ankle_l_in and ankle_r_in baselines are TBD. Cannot evaluate.

restrictions.label: Hinge terminates on lumbar rounding
restrictions.text: End the set at any hint of lumbar rounding rather than at a rep count.
restrictions.reason: Inseam is 41% of height against a 45–47% population norm. The long torso means a longer spinal moment arm, so the RDL is more lumbar-demanding at a given load than height alone predicts.

restrictions.label: No training to failure on dumbbell bench
restrictions.reason: No spotter. Failure means dumping the weights.

preset_catalog.doc: Consumer-facing starting points. A preset seeds a restriction the user then edits. Presets are not clinical advice and the UI must say so once, plainly, without turning into a disclaimer wall.

presets.label: Lower back — disc or strain history
Training alone
seeds: no training to failure on free-weight pressing

disclaimer: Restrictions are declared by the user. They are not a medical assessment and the app does not validate them clinically. Users with surgical history should confirm training tolerance with the surgeon or clinician who treated them.

match_semantics.rule: AND across scope keys, OR within a key. {equipment:[barbell], pattern:[horizontal_press]} means barbell AND horizontal press — it does NOT match a dumbbell bench press.
match_semantics.why: OR semantics silently over-restricts. A barbell-pressing ban evaluated as OR bans every horizontal press the user owns, including the dumbbell versions they explicitly said are fine. This is the single most important line in the file.
match_semantics.name_match: exercise_name_match is evaluated as an additional OR branch alongside the AND group — it exists to catch lifts not currently in the plan.
match_semantics.no_scope: A restriction with an empty scope matches nothing and must fail validation, not match everything.
